inspectedText: Antonia was cloned from Willa tissue collected1988 and produced living offspring. Most surviving population traced to seven founders; stored unrepresented genetics could broaden diversity. Three kits were born, one died; clones/offspring retained for research. This is not resurrection of Willa or proof that cloning alone rescued the species.
sourceQualityRationale: US Fish and Wildlife Service first-party project release with collaborators; precise genetic diversity multiplier needs original study rather than promotional shorthand.
